title: Total solar eclipse 2026: Here’s where Americans will see today’s eclipse
summary_full: Today brings a spectacular total solar eclipse as the Moon neatly aligns between Earth and the Sun. This extraordinary event will unveil its shadow over the Northern Hemisphere, with totality observable in regions like Greenland, Iceland, and certain areas of Spain and Portugal. A partial eclipse will also captivate viewers in various European countries and parts of North America.
